questions.original:
## Tutorial 1:
### Please complete the following questions using this jupyter notebook, SAVE it as HTML and upload to canvas.

#### (1) (20 points) use the jupyter notebook to print the following information:
#### Your student ID, your name, and your current time.
#### (2) (20 points) put the information above into a pandas dataframe (the table in step 3)
#### (3) (30 points) after a few seconds, add the second row of your id, name, time, expected scores
#### (4) (30 points) Perform matrix operations with numpy:
- Convert the score and grade columns into a numpy matrix.
- Print the matrix and its transpose.
- Calculate and print the sum of all scores.

answers.chinese: 先把自己的 ID、name 分别保存为两个变量，调用  存 first_time，再  三项。
answers.english: I obtain the current time during execution and print it together with my student ID and name.
I store the ID, name and first timestamp in row label 0 of a DataFrame. I state any additional score or grade columns needed for my interpretation of the later tasks.

answers.chinese: 现在 table 有标签 0、1 两行
answers.english: After waiting a few seconds, I read the clock again and insert a second row at a new label, keeping the first row and including the expected score.

answers.chinese: 若采用上述同一张教学表， 得两行 (80,1)/(90,1)。
answers.english: I select score followed by grade and convert those columns to a NumPy array. In this synthetic two-row example, its rows are (80,1) and (90,1).

answers.chinese: 打印 matrix 及 ；转置后两行分别为 (80,90)/(1,1)。
answers.english: I print the original array and its transpose. Transposition exchanges rows and columns, so the transposed rows are (80,90) and (1,1).

answers.chinese: 这里 “all scores” 只指分数。
answers.english: I sum only the score column, giving 170 for this synthetic example. I exclude grade codes from the score total.
